build_summary.creator_opinion: A high-damage PvP build crafted around the Palace Tachi medium weapon. By stacking Charisma and Intelligence pre-shrine, it maximizes armor penetration and charm synergies, paired with Shadowcast for massive mantra modifications and Contractor for execute capabilities.
strengths: High armor penetration (+15% PEN from Cult of Personality)
Strong guard-break synergies with Cornered Fool
High ether pool allowing giant modified mantras
Critical attack execute via Contractor Oath
weaknesses: Low base swing speed on the weapon

talents.name: Cult of Personality
talents.description: Gains +3% PEN for each person Charmed, capping at +15% PEN.

talents.name: Cornered Fool
talents.description: Blockbreaking a Charmed opponent procs Twisted for 5s, making them take and deal more damage.

talents.name: Etherguard
talents.description: Warped Blue Gems provide bonus effect when landed using a mantra.

talents.name: I'm Blue
talents.description: Improves the efficiency of Blue Gems used.

mantras.name: Rising Shadow
mantras.modifications: Modified to combo into critical attack

mantras.name: Shadow Meteor
mantras.modifications: Gigantic mantra modification via Blue Gems

combo_and_playstyle_guide.summary: Charm opponents from range using modified mantras to gain +15% PEN from Cult of Personality. Use the Palace Tachi critical attack to break guards, which triggers Cornered Fool for increased damage. Utilize Contractor Oath execution on critical hits when opponents are downed or low.
key_tips: Use Sing/Taunt on cooldown to keep opponents Charmed for free damage and penetration.
Unshift lock after a parry to land Shadow Meteor behind opponents.
When using Judgement, hold parry/f key up close to predict and punish opponent vents.
